verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own AI agents, which users create by describing a workflow in natural language. Agents can be assigned items, and its example of scoring open deals shows AI ranking work items, so automated triage is plausible within the product's agent capability. No first-party evidence shows triage or prioritization of incoming bugs or tasks specifically, and nothing shows agents firing automatically on new items rather than on assignment or mention. Missing for 10: explicit bug/task triage and prioritization feature or template, documented automatic triggering of agents on newly created items, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
Score our open deals and send proposals to anyone above 80%.
Fire when an agent is messaged, assigned an item, or mentioned in an update.
